title: La Liga: Hattrick Hero Julian Alvarez Helps Atletico Madrid Sink Valiant Rayo Vallecano | Sports News - News18
text: Atletico Madrid managed to edge out Rayo Vallecano 3-2 in the La Liga encounter between the sides on Wednesday at the Metropolitano as Julian Alvarez starred for the Capital City side with a hat-trick. Alvarez opened the scoring in the 15th minute before strikes from Pep Chavarria and Alvaro Garcia Rivera helped Rayo move in front. But, Alvarez struck in the 80th and 88th minutes to help his side to all points on offer. ALSO READ| EFL Cup: Arsenal Sink Port Vale As Eberechi Eze Strikes, Manchester City Down Huddersfield “We needed to get three points to get confidence from winning, we’ve been playing well but because of small details we weren’t getting good results," Alvarez said following the thrilling win. “We have to keep working and improve some things to get on a winning run," the Argentine striker added. Alvarez, who missed a penalty in Atletico’s frustrating draw at Mallorca last weekend, opened the scoring at the Metropolitano stadium. The 25-year-old, who joined from Manchester City in 2024, volleyed home from Marcos Llorente’s looping cross after 15 minutes to start the match. The striker should have scored a second before half-time but fired high over the crossbar from Nahuel Molina’s perfectly judged ball. Visitors Rayo punished the hosts in first-half stoppage time when Pep Chavarria scored one of the goals of the season, a long-range bullet that ripped into the top corner past Atletico goalkeeper Jan Oblak. Rayo substitute Alvaro Garcia put his team ahead when he was played in on goal, rounding Oblak before squeezing the ball home from a tight angle. This enraged Atletico, and they began pouring forward, quickly finding an equaliser. Rayo goalkeeper Augusto Batalla saved an effort from Simeone’s son Giuliano, but Alvarez was on hand to blast the rebound home from point-blank range. Giuliano then crashed a shot off the crossbar as Atletico pushed for a winner. With Rayo reeling, Alvarez completed his treble in the 88th minute, producing a superb finish to beat Batalla from the edge of the box. After grumbling about being substituted during the Mallorca game, Alvarez showed his coach against Rayo why he is best left on the pitch.
